reasoning: On the season so far the Clippers are the stronger team; with home court the Clippers start about 6 points better, in a game of about 229 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Jazz.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Clippers win 65 times in 100, by about 5; most games like this end between 202 and 250 total points.
